name: pyw90
description: Validate spin-resolved DFT-Wannier comparisons, run projector-targeted and gap-constrained per-spin energy-window searches with human-gated refinement, and retain a compatible low-level PyW90 adapter.

compare_required: Explicit collinear spin_up and spin_down DFT band files
Explicit Fermi energy plus the OUTCAR source that contains the same last E-fermi
VASP line-mode KPOINTS and one Wannier labelinfo per spin
Distinct seedname, expected_num_wann, win, wout, checkpoint declaration, band and labelinfo for each spin
Display and metric energy windows relative to the explicit Fermi reference
compare_checks: input existence, non-empty size and SHA-256
KPOINTS versus labelinfo normalized segment-label hash
win versus wout num_wann, num_bands and actual outer/frozen windows
local checkpoint hash or explicit unavailable reason
explicit override before a mismatched or partial lineage can be used diagnostically
window_scan_required: One per-spin regular-grid seed .eig for PyW90-style state-count feasibility
One immutable seed .win template and explicit Fermi energy
One same-spin DFT line-path band reference used only for fit scoring
Expected num_wann, finite candidate/refinement limits, explicit local output directory
Automatic .amn or processed-PROCAR projector-weight target, or an explicit arbitrary energy target relative to E_F
Projector-support target, an independent frozen seed/candidate policy with explicit disentanglement headroom, and a scientific ranking subwindow
Optional explicit local Wannier90 argv and shared interface files for run
Manual review.quality=poor for the same spin before refine
window_scan_checks: outer lower edge lies at the nearest complete global .eig gap below the target unless deep-gap fallback is explicitly enabled
outer window contains the complete projector-support target, at least num_wann states at every .eig k point, and no more than the configured excess-state ceiling
frozen window is independent of the target, uses lower projector-weight coverage tiers or reviewed explicit candidates, and preserves minimum disentanglement headroom at every .eig k point
automatic target is the narrowest energy interval containing the requested cumulative projector weight and may cross E_F
production template is never edited and every candidate has a stable identity
shell, SSH, scheduler and PyW90 auto argv are rejected
primary ranking requires completed disentanglement/localization and matching candidate win/wout windows
primary RMSE/MAE/maximum error use a scientific subwindow inside projector support while a broader metric remains diagnostic
optional excess adjacent-band-jump gate flags cross-gap spikes that aggregate RMSE can hide
candidate primary metrics must share one DFT band offset and reference sample count or best-candidate selection is blocked
initial and refinement candidates, workers, timeout and rounds obey hard limits

low_level_configuration.command: argv whose first item is eig, pre, or cmp; auto is rejected
low_level_configuration.input_dir: relative to the request file when not absolute
low_level_configuration.output_dir: relative to the request file when not absolute
low_level_configuration.executable: plain command resolved through PATH or path resolved relative to the request file

window_measure_required: Exact-source curves.csv produced by the workbench comparison
Fixed DFT energy interval and explicit shared band offset; JSON metrics returned on stdout

compare_artifacts: preflight.json with resolved identities, hashes, shapes, path hash and lineage status
metrics.json with common order-preserving DFT band offset and energy-window-bounded overall/per-band MAE, RMSE and maximum difference
two-panel PNG, LZW TIFF, editable-text PDF and SVG with disconnected k-path segments drawn independently
run.json with outputs, warnings and scientific boundary
output_contract.compare_success: run succeeds only after the complete contract passes; lineage mismatch/partial status requires a visible explicit diagnostic override
window_scan_artifacts: window_scan_manifest.json with candidate identities, relative/absolute windows, .eig state counts, run status and provenance
one isolated candidate directory per window with an immutable generated seed .win and declared shared inputs
per-attempt stdout, stderr and run_status JSON for optional local execution
score.json with scientific-subwindow primary metrics, broader full-window diagnostics, shape-jump evidence, and a convergence/lineage/optional-shape-gated ranking
fit_overlay.png, fit_overlay.pdf and fit_overlay.svg in each scored candidate directory for human band-shape review
bounded refinement candidates linked to the current eligible best candidate and manual poor review
output_contract.window_scan_success: A candidate enters the primary ranking only when the local artifacts exist, the wout is complete with disentanglement and localization convergence, and its actual windows match the generated candidate win.
low_level_artifacts: pyw90_run.json with argv, cwd, return code, hashes, versions, environment and log paths
output_contract.interpretation: Comparison metrics are bounded interface/model-fidelity diagnostics. They do not prove Wannier convergence and cannot be attributed to a current win when wout/checkpoint lineage differs.

executables: optional caller-selected local wannier90.x for window-scan run

authorization_policy.notes: Only caller-selected local paths are read or written. The window-scan mode may execute a finite explicit local Wannier90 argv with shell disabled; the extension does not install software, run VASP, submit jobs, edit production inputs, expose PyW90 auto, or manage a scheduler.

tests.status_note: 0.5.1 adds a separate measure JSON-file protocol for human-gated workbench rounds; fixed DFT sampling retains errors when a fitted band leaves the target interval. Existing standalone search is unchanged.

source_provenance.notes: The adapter scripts are authored locally around external PyW90 1.0.7. PyW90 GPL source is not bundled. Comparison and bounded search incorporate the 2026-09-01 Luna effort benchmark failure modes and the upstream state-count/evaluate principles without exposing upstream auto.
